cases.title: Banh Mi with NO Pate?! #vietnamfood #banhmi
cases.description: Address: 39 Nguyen Trai, District 1, HCMC
cases.descriptionRawFromYoutube:
Banh Mi with NO Pate?!

Yup feels like it’s a thing, we saw this spot where the line was long just near the famous Banh Mi Huynh Hoa 🥖

It’s run by two lovely auntie, one preparing the banh mi toppings and the other cooking the aromaric pork meatballs.

📍 Bánh Mì Thịt Nướng Ngon Saigon or also known as Bánh Mì 37 

Address: 39 Nguyen Trai, District 1, HCMC

Follow @nickandhelmi for more Travel and Food Guides
